author: Unreal Engine
description:
Forget baked animations. Software developer Skyreal is bringing scientific real-time physics to Unreal Engine 5. Simulating flexible parts like hoses, wiring harnesses, and complex kinematics in real time has always been the “final boss” of industrial simulation. 

In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, you’ll witness a world-first integration of XDE, a scientific-grade physics engine, directly into Unreal Engine. Through live, unscripted demos performed on stage, Skyreal showcases previously impossible scenarios: complex cable routing with precise flexibility, mechanical behavior, snap-fit assembly of non-rigid components, and jitter-free collision handling on massive datasets. 

Discover how the team pushed the boundaries of UE5 integration to achieve millimeter-accurate interactions for demanding industries including aerospace, automotive, naval, defense, energy, and beyond—turning Unreal Engine into a true engineering lab. If you’re a developer looking to bridge the
title: Beyond Native: Real-Time Scientific & Cable Simulation in UE5 | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
User-generated content (UGC) is becoming a core pillar in game development, backed with industry research showing increased revenue, player retention, and even long-term revenue increases in DLC sales. 

With the increased adoption by studios across PC, consoles, and mobile, understanding the production and engineering advantages of supporting UGC effectively has never been more important. 

With over 300 titles shipped across more than a dozen platforms, mod.io has seen these challenges first hand and understands what it takes to deliver scalable, cross-platform UGC support. 

This talk explores architectural strategies to implement cross-platform UGC support in your own title using Unreal Engine’s native systems. Rather than doing a deep dive into complex code, mod.io focuses on common patterns and structures to make your game easily moddable.

title: PAK to the Future: UGC in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
